adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update`, the diff shows `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` followed by `save_host(host)` with no guard. `save_host` immediately calls `host.host = ...` and `host.category_id = ...`, which will raise `NoMethodError` if no record exists for that id. That would turn a PUT to a nonexistent id into a 500 instead of a 404/appropriate error.
